data.revised_prompt:
Design a realistic production-quality desktop SaaS admin UI redesign for a Chinese private-domain community management system, using the attached current product screenshot as the primary visual source and preserving its existing brand language: white and very light gray surfaces, black text and controls, vivid acid-lime #CCFF00 accents, compact monochrome iconography, restrained 6–8px radii, quiet utilitarian operations-tool character, left navigation and top utility bar. Landscape composition, 1440x1024.

Concept 1: High-density operations workbench. Active page title: “微信群管理”. Keep the existing sidebar structure and top utility bar language. In the main content area, create a compact page title and a single efficient action/filter row with 地区, 群类型, 群管理员, search, reset. Add four small inline KPI summaries without decorative cards: 群总数, 接近满员, 待更新群码, 今日入群. Main content is a polished grouped data table with realistic Chinese rows and columns: 群名称, 地区, 归属微信, 群类型, 群管理员, 人数/容量 with progress, 群码状态, 今日入群, 操作. Use row separators, subtle sticky header feel, clear status chips, inline QR icon, and compact actions 查看成员 / 编辑. Include functional-looking pagination. Make near-capacity and expired-QR states immediately scannable. No cards inside cards, no oversized title, no gradients, no purple, no marketing content, no browser chrome, no explanatory feature text. Readable Chinese typography, intentional spacing, no clipped text.

Visual details: very clean enterprise dashboard, subtle shadowing only, dense but readable table rows, precise spacing, monochrome icons, lime highlight for primary action and active nav, status chips in lime/yellow/neutral/soft red only, realistic Chinese data rows with different group states, a few rows nearly full and a few QR code status expired/needs update. Top bar includes compact utility items and brand area consistent with source screenshot. Sidebar includes nested sections and badges but preserve overall structure. Make it look like a true frontend admin product screenshot, not a mockup or illustration.
